I answered Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket number is #88412.

That's the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing during the BOL barcode scan. Tobias raised it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025. He first called the customer "TP", then confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging (TSP), not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so this is something they could see themselves.

There's a second Door 6 ticket at the same customer, #4912, about a "phantom lock" at their Marietta plant. It only appears in a deal-desk email that I couldn't confirm Hollis can see, and it's a different problem, so I left it out of the reply.
